items.name: Target
items.headline: Raises full-year outlook after third-quarter report
items.catalyst: Q3 2026 results and updated guidance (Nov. 18, SEC Exhibit 99).
items.thesis: Net sales were $27,067 million, up 7.1%, with comparable sales up 5.6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.65, including $0.50 from tariff refunds; full-year EPS guidance is $10.65 to $11.40.

items.name: NVIDIA
items.headline: Reports fiscal Q3 results and guides Q4 revenue to $130.0 billion
items.catalyst: Fiscal Q3 2027 results and Q4 outlook (Form 8-K, Nov. 17).
items.thesis: Revenue was $115.8 billion, up 103% on the year, with Data Center at $107.6 billion. The Q4 outlook of $130.0 billion, plus or minus 3%, assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China.

items.name: Home Depot
items.headline: Reports third-quarter sales growth of 4.9%
items.thesis: Net sales were $43,398 million, up 4.9%, and comparable sales rose 2.2%. Diluted EPS was $3.72 versus $3.62 a year earlier.

items.name: Walt Disney
items.headline: Reports fiscal fourth-quarter revenue up 16%
items.thesis: Revenues were $25,947 million versus $22,464 million a year earlier, and diluted EPS was $1.51 versus $0.73. The quarter had one additional week versus the prior-year quarter.

items.name: Nike
items.headline: Reaffirms fiscal 2027 guidance and outlines Pace restructuring
items.catalyst: Form 8-K (Nov. 17) with fiscal 2027 guidance and restructuring plan.
items.thesis: Nike expects fiscal 2027 revenue to decline in the high-single-digit range and adjusted EPS of $1.15 to $1.35. It expects about $2.5 billion of annualized run-rate savings from Pace by fiscal 2031.

items.name: Cheniere Energy
items.headline: Closes $1.2 billion of senior notes due 2037
items.catalyst: Form 8-K (Nov. 17) reporting closing of a notes sale.
items.thesis: The 5.800% Senior Notes due 2037 were issued at 99.313% of par and mature March 15, 2037.
